Ana (Sales): NexaHealth POC just hit a blocker: their TS desktop app behind corporate proxy can't connect to our hosted API. They see ECONNRESET / 407 Proxy Authentication required.
Sam (Eng): Do they use a forward proxy that terminates TLS? 407 usually means proxy auth. Any logs/screenshots?
Ana (Sales): attaching logs from their dev: 
```
fetch error: error:1408F10B:SSL routines:ssl3_get_record:wrong version number
errno: ECONNRESET
proxy: 10.10.0.5:3128
``` 
Jordan (SE): Two quick questions: (1) is this running in Electron/Node or a browser? (2) can they curl our health endpoint directly from the impacted host?
Ana (Sales): It's an internal Electron/TS app. They tried curl and got 407 as well.
Sam (Eng): Ok proxy is enforcing auth. For Node/Electron they need to set HTTPS_PROXY + either include creds or use an auth-capable proxy agent. Example (node-fetch + proxy-agent):
```
const HttpsProxyAgent = require('https-proxy-agent');
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent('http://user:pass@proxy.company:3128');
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', { agent });
```
Jordan (SE): If they can't embed credentials, recommend corporate single-sign-on / NTLM/Kerberos or a transparent proxy. Also check NO_PROXY to bypass for internal/external domains as allowed.
Luis (SRE): Note: their repeated retries while auth fails are causing bursts that look like client-driven 429s on our side. Advise them to add exponential backoff + moderate socket timeouts. Python example: 
```
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry
s = requests.Session()
retries = Retry(total=5, backoff_factor=0.5, status_forcelist=[429,502,503,504])
s.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries))
```
Sam (Eng): We should also offer a temporary quota bump or a dedicated testing route to avoid shared-rate impacts while they iterate. @Jordan can you confirm a temporary bump? :eyes:
Jordan (SE): I can request a short trial bump for NexaHealth. Need org id + expected QPS from Ana.
Ana (Sales): I'll collect org id and a sample traffic profile. One more thing: they see intermittent TLS handshake failures when the proxy is in-path — possibly ALPN/TLS version mismatch. Any quick mitigations?
Sam (Eng): They can try forcing TLSv1.2 in Node/Electron or disable HTTP/2 negotiation if the proxy mangles ALPN. Example when creating a TLS agent: `secureProtocol: 'TLSv1_2_method'`.
Luis (SRE): Also confirm the corporate proxy's CA. Many corporate proxies resign TLS with their own cert — customers must add the proxy CA to the OS/Electron trust store. Don't suggest `--ignore-certificate-errors`.
Jordan (SE): Add a runbook step: attempt a direct curl with proxy creds, then try bypassing proxy via NO_PROXY for `api.redwood.ai` if company policy allows.
Sam (Eng): I'll draft Node + Python snippets for their engineers and include retry/backoff and agent examples.
deploy-bot: Ticket created #POC-4827, assigned to Jordan (SE).
Ana (Sales): Thanks team — I'll send the runbook + ask for org id and sample load. Will update once they try. :thumbsup:
